channel.name: A&E CA
channel.title: Lakefront Luxury
channel.desc: Paul and Sharena are on the hunt for their dream lakefront home, balancing Sharena's love of glitz with Paul's rustic tastes. Their first stop is a sleek, modern home with mirrored cabinets, crystal light fixtures, a built-in vanity in the primary suite, and a sparkling pool, perfect for Sharena. Next, they tour a rustic retreat with vaulted ceilings, exposed beams, and a trail leading through nature to the lake, Paul's ideal escape. The final home blends both styles with an oversized kitchen.
